target: Smooth 60 fps on live vlang.io remains open
scope: Changed scroll position at changed native layer publication after updateLayer; entire first-to-last actual input window. Physical display scanout is unmeasured.

protocol.profile_cache: Fresh private empty profile/cache; direct live HTTPS; automatic author scripts; OS filesystem/shader caches retained.
protocol.pixel_bound: Existing maximum channel error three, unchanged.

decisions.sparse_input: Off; first pair mixed and second mean/p95 regress. No performance acceptance.
decisions.covered_redraw: Safe default-on delivery guard; zero eligible input deliveries, no timing pairs or FPS credit.
decisions.early_context: Prepared before input; paired means and maxima improve, but both p95 intervals regress. Smooth 60 remains unresolved.
decisions.offscreen_stationary: Opt-in after mixed live pairs. Diagnostic reuses 63 input-window immutable frames; no acceptance.
decisions.bounded_pointwise: Off; recovered cohort pairs are mixed and both candidate p95 intervals regress. First timing attempt is invalidated by disk exhaustion; all attempts are retained.
decisions.static_msaa_images: Off; initial live diagnostic fails the unchanged pixel bound (five levels) on explicitly clipped images. The narrowed path excludes explicit clips and nearest sampling and passes three levels live, but paired timing remains mixed.
decisions.retained_upload_bytes: Off; first pair improves but second mean and p95 regress despite confirmed exact-byte reuse.
decisions.retained_media_paint: Off; focused storage, retained-source, revision ownership and default/enabled-mode checks pass. Live validation awaits publication of the completed new bundle while another measurement holds the shared bundle lease.
decisions.owned_provider: Removed: original provider already shares bytes and retains its owner; no production change or FPS credit.

limitations: Mean rates above 60 do not establish smooth 60 fps. Diagnostics and instrumentation supply no unprofiled performance credit.
Every attempted cohort and focused failure is retained; actual host loads, input cadence, pinned identities, boundary gaps and exits are in the raw records.

The first current-V check is blocked by a concurrently added &&LayoutState argument; a one-character integration correction removes the redundant address operator without committing the surrounding foreign work.
Two production builds fail for disk exhaustion; completed old compiler inputs are archived and verified before removing their expanded files.

Completed trial caches are stored losslessly by content hash. The manifest and verified object archive preserve original bytes, paths and timestamps; empty on-disk cache directories must not be interpreted as empty measured caches.
No browser bundle or source checkout is copied into a benchmark directory. Native tests extract only their existing entry-point harness.
